TVM_CITY.desc: One guide, read once, and you're ready. Trivandrum's temples, museums and beaches in one shared-seat day: the route, what to expect at each stop, what to carry, and how to book.
TVM_CITY.itin:
7:45 AM Pickup — Trivandrum Central / East Fort / Trivandrum Airport: Choose any of the three pickup points. Guests board; water and snack packs handed out for the day.
8:15 AM — Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple: Exterior and heritage-architecture view for non-Hindu guests. Interior access is Hindus-only with a strict dress code, flagged clearly before booking.
9:15 AM — Museum Junction: Napier Museum, the Zoo, Kanakakunnu Palace grounds and Sree Chitra Art Gallery, all within walking distance.
12:30 PM — Lunch: Own expense, or a paid add-on at a partner restaurant — guest's choice at booking.
1:30 PM — Veli Tourist Village: Lagoon, floating bridge and optional boating.
3:00 PM — Chalai Bazaar: Flex stop for local market browsing; skipped if the day is running long.
4:00 PM — Shankumugham Beach: Free entry, close to base: the day's sunset-and-photos finish.
5:15 PM Drop-off — Central, East Fort, the Airport — or your own stop: A different drop within the city is free; a small surcharge applies beyond a set radius.
TVM_CITY.gtk:
🛕 Padmanabhaswamy Temple: Interior access is for Hindus only, with a strict dress code. Non-Hindu guests get an exterior and heritage-architecture view. Ask us about the dress code when you book.
🏛️ Museum Junction: Napier Museum, the Zoo, Kanakakunnu and Sree Chitra Art Gallery are within walking distance. Entry is included in your seat. Napier and Sree Chitra are closed on Mondays.
🚣 Veli & 🛍️ Chalai: Boating at Veli is optional. Chalai Bazaar is a flex stop: we may skip it if the day runs long.
🏖️ Shankumugham Beach: Free entry, close to base. The relaxed, photos-and-sea-breeze finish to the day.
TVM_CITY.exc: Lunch (own expense or partner restaurant add-on); Veli boating (optional)
TVM_CITY.carry: Comfortable walking shoes; Clothing suitable for temple visits; Cash for lunch and optional boating; Your phone, charged, with our number saved

TVM_COASTAL.desc: One guide for the coast south of the city: Kovalam's lighthouse beaches, the Vizhinjam seaport and the Poovar backwaters. The route, the extras to budget for, what to carry, and how to book.
TVM_COASTAL.itin:
9:00 AM Pickup — Trivandrum Central / East Fort / Trivandrum Airport: Choose any of the three pickup points. Guests board; water and snack packs handed out. About 16 km down the coast road to the first stop.
9:30 AM — Kovalam — Lighthouse, Hawa & Samudra Beaches: Three linked crescent beaches below a rocky headland. Climb the working lighthouse for a coastal panorama, swim, or walk the promenade.
11:30 AM — Vizhinjam Seaport Viewpoint & Fishing Harbour: A short stop at India's newest deepwater transshipment port, 3 km south of Kovalam: ship-spotting alongside one of Kerala's busiest fishing harbours.
12:15 PM — Lunch: Own expense, or a paid add-on at a seafood restaurant near the harbour — guest's choice at booking.
2:00 PM — Poovar Backwaters: About 17 km on from Vizhinjam. A mangrove-lined channel leads to the golden sand bar where the Neyyar river meets the Arabian Sea. Boating is optional, paid directly to the boat operator at the jetty.
3:15 PM — Poovar Sand Bar — free time: Swim in the calm backwater on one side or the open sea on the other, with the day's best light for photos.
6:00 PM Drop-off — Central, East Fort, the Airport — or your own stop: A different drop within the city is free; a small surcharge applies beyond a set radius.
TVM_COASTAL.gtk:
🗼 Kovalam: Three crescent beaches: Lighthouse, Hawa and Samudra. Lighthouse climb is about ₹30, own expense. Swim or walk the promenade.
🚢 Vizhinjam: A short stop at India's newest deepwater transshipment port. Ship-spotting next to a busy fishing harbour.
🛶 Poovar boating: Not bundled: pay the boat operator directly. Some private clubs quote far above the notified fare. Ask for the government-notified rate. Our team will guide you at the jetty.
🏝️ Poovar Sand Bar: Calm backwater on one side, open sea on the other. Free time to swim and take photos.
TVM_COASTAL.exc: Lunch (own expense or seafood add-on); Lighthouse climb (~₹30); Poovar boating (optional)
TVM_COASTAL.carry: Swimwear and a towel; Sunscreen, hat and sunglasses; Cash for the boat and lighthouse; A change of clothes

TVM_VARKALA.desc: One guide for a full day at Kerala's only cliff-backed beach: the holy Papanasam spring, Sivagiri Mutt and the cliff-top promenade. The route, the optional paragliding, what to carry, and how to book.
TVM_VARKALA.itin:
8:00 AM Pickup — Trivandrum Central / East Fort / Trivandrum Airport: Choose any of the three pickup points. Guests board; water and snack packs handed out. About 42 km north, roughly 1.5 hours.
9:30 AM — Varkala Cliff & Papanasam Beach: Kerala's only beach backed by sheer red laterite cliffs: a cliff-top promenade of cafés and shops above, open beach below.
10:15 AM — Papanasam Spring & Janardanaswamy Temple: A natural spring at the base of the cliff, believed to wash away sins ("Papanasam" means exactly that), beside a Vishnu temple over a thousand years old.
11:30 AM — Free time & lunch: Cliff-top cafés, own expense. Varkala's promenade has the widest food choice of any kfGo tour.
1:00 PM — Sivagiri Mutt: Hilltop ashram of Sree Narayana Guru, one of Kerala's most significant social reformers: a quiet, garden-set pilgrimage site a short drive from the cliff.
2:30 PM — Back to the cliff — paragliding (optional): Seasonal and weather-permitting: a 15–20 minute tandem flight off the cliff with a licensed operator, paid direct.
4:30 PM — Sunset at the cliff: Varkala's signature moment: the sun dropping into the Arabian Sea, seen from the cliff edge.
6:30 PM Drop-off — Central, East Fort, the Airport — or your own stop: A different drop within the city is free; a small surcharge applies beyond a set radius.
TVM_VARKALA.gtk:
🏖️ Varkala Cliff: Sheer red laterite cliffs above Papanasam Beach. Cliff-top cafés and shops; the widest food choice of any kfGo tour.
🛕 Papanasam Spring & Temple: A natural spring believed to wash away sins. Beside the Janardanaswamy Vishnu temple, over a thousand years old.
🕊️ Sivagiri Mutt: Hilltop ashram of Sree Narayana Guru. A quiet pilgrimage site: please dress and behave respectfully.
🪂 Paragliding: 15–20 minute tandem flight off the cliff. Depends on season and wind on the day. Not bundled into the kfGo price.
TVM_VARKALA.carry: Swimwear and a towel; Sunscreen and a hat; Modest clothing for the temple and Sivagiri; Cash or card for cafés and paragliding

TVM_KOLLAM.desc: One guide for our farthest tour north: Thangassery lighthouse and fort, the eight-armed Ashtamudi Lake and Kollam's quieter beaches. The route, the optional lake cruise, what to carry, and how to book.
TVM_KOLLAM.itin:
7:30 AM Pickup — Trivandrum Central / East Fort / Trivandrum Airport: Choose any of the three pickup points. Guests board; water and snack packs handed out. About 66 km north, roughly 2 hours.
9:30 AM — Thangassery Lighthouse & Fort: One of Kerala's oldest working lighthouses (1902), on the site of an old Portuguese fort. Climb for a coastal view, with the fort ruins and St. Thomas Church alongside.
10:30 AM — Thangassery Beach: A quieter beach right beside the lighthouse — a walk, not a crowd.
11:15 AM — Ashtamudi Lake: Kerala's second-largest wetland and the backwaters' southern gateway; eight interlocking channels give it its name ("ashta" = eight, "mudi" = branch). Shikara or houseboat cruises available at the jetty.
1:00 PM — Lunch: Own expense, or a paid add-on. Kollam is Kerala's historic cashew-processing hub, so ask for it on the menu.
2:00 PM — Thirumullavaram Beach: A calmer alternative to the lighthouse beach, with a small shoreline temple: good for a slower afternoon stop.
3:15 PM — Kollam Town — Chinnakada: Flex stop at the town centre's landmark clock tower and market area; skipped if the day is running long.
6:30 PM Drop-off — Central, East Fort, the Airport — or your own stop: A different drop within the city is free; a small surcharge applies beyond a set radius.
TVM_KOLLAM.gtk:
🗼 Thangassery: One of Kerala's oldest working lighthouses (1902), on an old Portuguese fort site. Lighthouse entry is your own expense. Fort ruins and St. Thomas Church alongside.
🛶 Ashtamudi Lake: Kerala's second-largest wetland; 'ashta' = eight, 'mudi' = branch. Shikara or houseboat cruise optional, paid direct.
🌊 The beaches: Thangassery Beach: a walk, not a crowd. Thirumullavaram: calmer, with a small shoreline temple.
🕰️ Kollam town: Chinnakada clock tower and market: a flex stop. Kollam is Kerala's cashew hub, so ask for it at lunch.
TVM_KOLLAM.exc: Lunch (own expense or add-on); Lighthouse entry; Lake cruise (optional)
TVM_KOLLAM.carry: Sunscreen and a hat; Comfortable shoes for the lighthouse climb; Cash for entry and the cruise; A light snack for the 2-hour drive

TVM_JATAYU.desc: One guide for our longest day: the world's largest bird sculpture at Jatayu Earth's Center, Kerala's only cable car, and an unhurried finish on the Varkala cliffs. The route, the optional adventures, what to carry, and how to book.
TVM_JATAYU.itin:
7:00 AM Pickup — Trivandrum Central / East Fort / Trivandrum Airport: Choose any of the three pickup points. Guests board; water and snack packs handed out. About 50 km inland, roughly 1.3 hours on MC Road (SH-1).
8:20 AM — Jatayu Earth's Center — the sculpture & cable car: A 200-foot bird sculpture atop Jatayu Rock Hill, billed as the world's largest, built around the Ramayana legend of the eagle who fought Ravana to defend Sita. Kerala's only cable car carries you up.
9:30 AM — Museum, 360° deck & the Jatayu–Ravana theatre: Exhibition rooms inside the sculpture, an observation deck in its head, and a multi-dimensional mini theatre staging the legendary battle.
10:45 AM — Hill 2 forest trek (optional): A guided hour through the park's private forest on the second hill: quieter and greener than the sculpture crowds.
11:45 AM — Adventure Park (optional): Up to twenty activities, from zip-lining and archery to paintball and rappelling, priced by the park itself.
12:30 PM — Drive on to Varkala: Only 27 km further, about 40 minutes: the short hop that makes pairing the two worthwhile.
1:15 PM — Lunch, Varkala cliff-top: Own expense, at one of the cliff-top restaurants overlooking Papanasam Beach.
2:15 PM — Varkala Cliff & Papanasam Beach — free time: Kerala's only beach backed by sheer red laterite cliffs, with the cliff-top promenade for an unhurried finish to the day.
6:15 PM Drop-off — Central, East Fort, the Airport — or your own stop: About 42 km back, roughly 1.3 hours. Free drop within the city; a small surcharge beyond a set radius.
TVM_JATAYU.gtk:
🦅 Jatayu Earth's Center: A 200-foot sculpture on Jatayu Rock Hill, from the Ramayana legend. Kerala's only cable car carries you up: included.
🏛️ Inside the sculpture: Museum rooms, a 360° deck in the head, and a mini theatre of the Jatayu–Ravana battle.
🧗 Optional extras: Hill 2 guided forest trek (optional). Adventure Park activities, paid direct to the park.
🏖️ Varkala Cliff: Lunch at a cliff-top restaurant, own expense. Free time on the promenade. Paragliding optional, seasonal, paid direct.
TVM_JATAYU.exc: Adventure Park (optional); Lunch at Varkala; Paragliding (optional)
TVM_JATAYU.carry: Comfortable shoes for the rock hill; Sunscreen, hat and water; Cash or card for adventure activities; Your phone, charged, for the 360° views

TVM_KANYAKUMARI.desc: One guide for India's southernmost tip, where three seas meet: Padmanabhapuram Palace, Suchindram temple, the Vivekananda Rock Memorial and the Thiruvalluvar Statue. The route, closures to plan around, what to carry, and how to book.
TVM_KANYAKUMARI.itin:
7:30 AM Pickup — Trivandrum Central / East Fort / Trivandrum Airport: Water and snacks handed out. About 90 km south-east, roughly 3 hours.
9:00 AM — Padmanabhapuram Palace: On the way, near Thuckalay: the old Travancore palace, famous for its carved wooden halls and murals.
10:15 AM — Suchindram Thanumalayan Temple: A rare trimurti temple with musical stone pillars. Free entry.
11:15 AM — Arulmigu Bhagavathy Amman Temple: The temple the town is named for, near the beach.
12:00 PM — Kanyakumari Beach — the three seas confluence: Where the Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal and Indian Ocean meet.
12:45 PM — Lunch: Own expense, at one of the seafront restaurants in Kanyakumari town.
2:00 PM — Vivekananda Rock Memorial & Thiruvalluvar Statue: A short ferry to the twin rock islets: the memorial where Swami Vivekananda is said to have meditated, and the 133-foot Thiruvalluvar Statue beside it.
4:00 PM — Kanyakumari Lighthouse & Sunset Point: A working lighthouse beside the point where locals gather in the evening. The drive home means an early-evening view rather than the full sunset.
8:00 PM Drop-off — Central, East Fort, the Airport — or your own stop: About 90 km back, roughly 3 hours. Free drop within the city; a small surcharge beyond a set radius.
TVM_KANYAKUMARI.gtk:
🛕 Suchindram Temple: A rare trimurti temple: Shiva, Vishnu and Brahma in one sanctum. Famous for its musical stone pillars. Free entry; donation-based.
🏯 Padmanabhapuram Palace: The old Travancore royal palace, known for its carved wooden halls. Closed on Mondays; entry is your own expense. Shoes are removed inside.
⛴️ Rock Memorial: Short ferry to the twin rock islets. Vivekananda memorial and the 133-foot Thiruvalluvar Statue. Closed on Tuesdays.
🙏 Amman Temple: The temple the town is named for. Open mornings until 12:30 PM — we visit at 11:15 AM. Dress code applies.
TVM_KANYAKUMARI.exc: Lunch at seafront restaurants; Palace entry; Temple donations (optional)
TVM_KANYAKUMARI.carry: Modest clothing for temple visits; Original photo ID; Sunscreen and a hat; A light jacket for the evening drive back

TVM_SABARIMALA.desc: Whole-vehicle pilgrimage from Trivandrum to the Nilakkal base camp: pickup, the drive, no waiting charges while you complete darshan, and the drive home. Full Traveller works out to ₹917 per pilgrim.
TVM_SABARIMALA.inc: Vehicle and driver for the day; No waiting charges at Nilakkal; Driver bata
TVM_SABARIMALA.exc: KSRTC Nilakkal–Pampa bus; Food, stay, offerings
TVM_SABARIMALA.carry: Virtual Queue coupon (printed); Original photo ID; Irumudi; Change of clothes

TVM_KOCHI.desc: Flying out of Cochin International? Start from your own doorstep in Trivandrum and step out at the terminal — or land in Kochi and we bring you home.
TVM_KOCHI.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home, hotel, Central, East Fort or Trivandrum Airport — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~245 km on NH 66: About 5–6 hours via Kollam and Alappuzha, with a refreshment stop on the way.
Drop-off — Cochin International Airport: Departures at Nedumbassery. Reverse trips start from the arrivals hall. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
TVM_KOCHI.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Plan to reach the airport 3 hours before an international flight and 2 hours before a domestic one. Share your flight number so we can track delays.
🧳 Luggage: Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags. Families with large bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller.
🔁 Return trips: Arriving in Kochi? We pick you up from arrivals. Up to 1 hour of waiting is included for flight delays.
📍 Other Kochi drops: Kochi city, Fort Kochi or a hotel in Ernakulam? Ask us for a quote.
TVM_KOCHI.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
TVM_KOCHI.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; A light snack for the drive

TVM_ALAPPUZHA.desc: A private day on Kerala's famous backwaters: a cruise through Vembanad's canals, a Kerala meal and an evening on Alappuzha beach.
TVM_ALAPPUZHA.itin:
6:30 AM — Pickup: Home, hotel, Central, East Fort or Trivandrum Airport
10:00 AM — Backwater cruise: Shikara or day houseboat through the canals and paddy fields of the Vembanad backwaters. (Cruise paid direct to the operator)
1:00 PM — Kerala lunch: Own expense — try karimeen (pearl spot) on a banana leaf.
2:30 PM — Alappuzha Beach & lighthouse: The old pier, the lighthouse and the long sandy beach.
4:00 PM — Krishnapuram Palace (on the way back): 18th-century Travancore palace at Kayamkulam, home to a famous Gajendra Moksham mural. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
8:30 PM — Drop-off: Back to your door or any point in Trivandrum.
TVM_ALAPPUZHA.gtk:
🛶 Choosing a boat: Shikara: small, canopy boat, best for 2–6 people for a few hours. Day houseboat: lunch on board, best for families. Overnight houseboat? Ask us to plan a 2-day trip.
💰 Paying for the boat: The cruise isn't in our price — pay the operator directly. Agree the hours and route before you board.
🏛️ Krishnapuram Palace: Closed on Mondays. On a Monday we add more beach time instead.
🌧️ Weather: Best from September to March. In heavy rain, cruises may be shortened.
TVM_ALAPPUZHA.inc: Private vehicle and driver; No waiting charges; Driver bata; Free drop anywhere in the city
TVM_ALAPPUZHA.exc: Boat cruise; Lunch; Palace entry; Tolls and parking
TVM_ALAPPUZHA.carry: Sunscreen and hat; Cash for the boat; Light cotton clothes

TVM_VAGAMON.desc: Rolling green meadows, pine forests and misty viewpoints — Kerala's quietest hill escape, about five hours from Trivandrum.
TVM_VAGAMON.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Pickup & drive: About 190 km via Kottayam and Erattupetta, roughly 5 hours.
Day 1 · afternoon — Pine forest & Vagamon meadows: Walk the pine valley and the rolling grass hills.
Day 1 · evening — Vagamon Lake: A calm lake ringed by tea and meadows. Overnight in Vagamon. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Kurisumala & Murugan Mala: Hilltop pilgrimage sites with sweeping valley views.
Day 2 · late morning — Paragliding (optional): Seasonal tandem flights at the Vagamon launch site. (Paid direct · weather-dependent)
Day 2 · ~8 PM — Home: Drive back to your door in Trivandrum.
TVM_VAGAMON.gtk:
🌲 Pine forest & meadows: Wear grippy shoes — slopes are slippery after rain. Mornings are misty; afternoons clearer.
🪂 Paragliding: Runs in season, weather-permitting. Not in our price — pay the operator directly.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel or homestay; we can suggest areas. Your driver stays nearby — his night allowance is in our price.
🧥 Weather: Cool evenings — bring a light jacket. Best from September to May.
TVM_VAGAMON.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Sightseeing in Vagamon; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
TVM_VAGAMON.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Paragliding and entry fees; Tolls and parking
TVM_VAGAMON.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes; Raincoat or umbrella; Cash for entry fees

TVM_MUNNAR.desc: Endless tea gardens, waterfalls on the way up, and the Nilgiri tahr of Eravikulam — Kerala's favourite hill station at your own pace.
TVM_MUNNAR.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive up: About 290 km via Kothamangalam, roughly 7–8 hours.
Day 1 · afternoon — Cheeyappara & Valara waterfalls: Roadside waterfalls on the climb into the hills. Overnight in Munnar. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Eravikulam National Park: Rajamala, home of the Nilgiri tahr. Park buses take you up. (Entry paid direct · usually closed for calving ~Feb–Mar)
Day 2 · midday — Tea Museum: How tea goes from leaf to cup in Munnar. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · afternoon — Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point & Top Station: Lake views, boating (optional) and the valley lookout at Top Station.
Day 3 — Drive home: Leave after breakfast; back in Trivandrum by evening.
TVM_MUNNAR.gtk:
🐐 Eravikulam: Book tickets in advance on busy days. Usually closed for the tahr calving season around February–March — check before you go.
🍃 Tea estates: Most tea gardens are private land — photograph from the roadside. Buy fresh tea at the museum or estate shops.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel; Munnar town, Chithirapuram and Pallivasal are popular. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🧥 Weather: Cold mornings, especially Dec–Jan. Hill roads are winding — carry motion sickness tablets if needed.
TVM_MUNNAR.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; All Munnar sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
TVM_MUNNAR.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Park, museum and boating fees; Tolls and parking
TVM_MUNNAR.carry: Warm jacket; Walking shoes; Motion sickness tablets; Cash for entry fees

TVM_WAYANAD.desc: Ancient cave carvings, misty lakes, dams and forest roads in Kerala's green north — a full road trip with your own vehicle and driver.
TVM_WAYANAD.itin:
Day 1 · 5:30 AM — Pickup & long drive north: About 470 km via NH 66 and the Thamarassery ghat, roughly 10 hours. Overnight in Wayanad. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Edakkal Caves: A short, steep trek to caves with prehistoric rock carvings. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 2 · afternoon — Banasura Sagar Dam & Phantom Rock: India's largest earth dam, with islands in the reservoir.
Day 3 · morning — Pookode Lake & Lakkidi viewpoint: A freshwater lake in the forest, and the view down the ghat. (Boating optional, paid direct)
Day 3 · afternoon — Soochipara Waterfalls: A forest walk to a tiered waterfall. (Entry own expense · check if open)
Day 4 — Drive home: Leave early; back in Trivandrum by night.
TVM_WAYANAD.gtk:
🪨 Edakkal Caves: Closed on Mondays — we plan around it. The climb is steep: not ideal for elders or small children.
🌧️ Forest sites: Waterfalls and treks can close after heavy rain. We check on the day and swap stops if needed.
🏨 Your stay: You book your resort or homestay; Kalpetta and Vythiri are central. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🛣️ The long drive: Day 1 and Day 4 are long road days with breaks. Want it easier? Add a night in Kozhikode — ask us.
TVM_WAYANAD.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 4 days; All Wayanad sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
TVM_WAYANAD.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry and boating fees; Tolls and parking
TVM_WAYANAD.carry: Trekking shoes; Raincoat; Light jacket; Cash for entry fees

TVM_OOTY.desc: The Nilgiris' classic hill stations: gardens and lakes in Ooty, tea country in Coonoor, and the famous toy train — your vehicle, your pace.
TVM_OOTY.itin:
Day 1 · 5:30 AM — Pickup & drive: About 556 km via Palakkad, Coimbatore and Mettupalayam, roughly 11 hours. Overnight in Ooty. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Botanical Garden & Rose Garden: Ooty's best-known gardens. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · afternoon — Ooty Lake & Doddabetta Peak: Boating (optional) and the highest point in the Nilgiris.
Day 3 · morning — Coonoor — Sim's Park & Dolphin's Nose: Tea country, gardens and a famous valley lookout.
Day 3 · optional — Nilgiri Mountain Railway: The UNESCO-listed toy train between Ooty and Coonoor. (Book tickets in advance · paid direct)
Day 4 — Drive home: Leave early; back in Trivandrum by night.
TVM_OOTY.gtk:
🚂 Toy train: Seats sell out — book on IRCTC well before your trip. We meet you at the other station with your vehicle.
🪪 Tamil Nadu entry: Ooty is in Tamil Nadu: interstate permit, border tax and any hill-station e-pass are billed at actual cost. We check entry rules before you travel.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel; Ooty town and Coonoor both work well. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🧥 Weather: Cold nights all year — bring warm clothes. Ghat roads have 36 hairpin bends from Mettupalayam side.
TVM_OOTY.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 4 days; Ooty and Coonoor sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
TVM_OOTY.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry, boating and toy train tickets; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
TVM_OOTY.carry: Warm jacket; Photo ID; Motion sickness tablets; Cash for entry fees

TVM_KODAIKANAL.desc: A star-shaped lake, cliff-edge walks and pillar rocks in the Palani hills — Tamil Nadu's cool retreat, with your own vehicle and driver.
TVM_KODAIKANAL.itin:
Day 1 · 5:30 AM — Pickup & drive: About 410 km, roughly 9–10 hours, climbing the ghat past Silver Cascade falls. Overnight in Kodaikanal. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Kodai Lake & Bryant Park: Boating or cycling round the lake, then the gardens. (Boating paid direct)
Day 2 · midday — Coaker's Walk: A cliff-edge path with views to the plains. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · afternoon — Pillar Rocks, pine forest & Guna Caves viewpoint: Granite pillars, tall pines and the famous caves lookout.
Day 3 — Drive home: Leave after breakfast; back in Trivandrum by night.
TVM_KODAIKANAL.gtk:
🪪 Tamil Nadu entry: Kodaikanal is in Tamil Nadu: interstate permit, border tax and any hill-station e-pass are billed at actual cost. We check entry rules before you travel.
🌫️ Viewpoints: Mist can hide Pillar Rocks and Coaker's Walk — mornings are usually clearer. We reorder stops for the best views.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel; near the lake is most convenient. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🧥 Weather: Cool all year, cold at night. Best from October to June.
TVM_KODAIKANAL.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; Kodaikanal sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
TVM_KODAIKANAL.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry and boating fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
TVM_KODAIKANAL.carry: Warm jacket; Photo ID; Walking shoes; Cash for entry fees

TVM_MYSORE.desc: Through Wayanad's forests and the Bandipur road to Mysore's palace, gardens and Srirangapatna — a royal road trip with your own vehicle.
TVM_MYSORE.itin:
Day 1 · 5:30 AM — Pickup & drive to Wayanad: About 470 km, roughly 10 hours. Overnight in Wayanad. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Wayanad to Mysore via Bandipur: About 130 km through forest — watch for deer and elephants. (Bandipur road closed to traffic at night)
Day 2 · afternoon — Chamundi Hill & Brindavan Gardens: The hilltop temple, then the musical fountain at Brindavan. (Entry own expense)
Day 3 — Mysore Palace, Srirangapatna & St Philomena's: The palace, Tipu Sultan's island fort and the Gothic cathedral. (Palace lit up on Sundays and holidays, evening)
Day 4 — Drive back to Wayanad / Kozhikode: Break the return journey. Overnight on the way. (Stay booked by you)
Day 5 — Home: Back in Trivandrum by evening.
TVM_MYSORE.gtk:
🏰 Mysore Palace: Plan a Sunday or public holiday evening to see the palace lit up. Shoes are removed inside — carry socks.
🪪 Karnataka entry: Mysore is in Karnataka: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We check entry rules before you travel.
🐘 Bandipur road: The forest stretch is closed to traffic at night — we plan daytime crossings. No stopping or feeding animals inside the forest.
🏨 Your stays: You book your hotels in Wayanad, Mysore and on the way back. Your driver's night allowances are in our price.
TVM_MYSORE.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 5 days; All Mysore and Wayanad sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
TVM_MYSORE.exc: Your hotels; Meals; Palace, garden and entry fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
TVM_MYSORE.carry: Photo ID; Socks for the palace; Light jacket; Cash for entry fees

TVM_PONMUDI.desc: Trivandrum's own hill station, an hour and a half away: 22 hairpin bends, tea slopes, misty viewpoints and a river stop on the way.
TVM_PONMUDI.itin:
7:30 AM — Pickup: Central · East Fort · Trivandrum Airport
8:45 AM — Kallar riverside & Golden Valley: A cool river stop at the foot of the hills.
9:30 AM — The 22 hairpin bends: The climb through forest and tea to about 1,100 m.
10:30 AM — Ponmudi top & viewpoints: Grassy ridges, mist and views over the Western Ghats.
12:00 PM — Tea estate & lunch: Walk among the tea; lunch own expense.
2:00 PM — Meenmutty Falls (if open): A short forest walk to a waterfall near Kallar. (Seasonal · entry own expense)
5:30 PM — Drop-off: Central, East Fort, Airport, or your own stop
TVM_PONMUDI.gtk:
🌫️ Weather: Cool and misty most of the year — bring a light jacket. In very heavy rain the Ponmudi road can be closed; we re-confirm the day before.
🛣️ Hairpin road: 22 bends on the climb — carry motion sickness tablets if needed. We stop on the way so nobody feels rushed.
💧 Meenmutty Falls: Open in season only, with a short forest walk. If closed, we spend more time at the top instead.
🍃 Tea estates: Most tea land is private — photograph from paths and roadsides. Leave no plastic: Ponmudi is a protected forest area.
TVM_PONMUDI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
TVM_PONMUDI.exc: Lunch; Meenmutty Falls entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
TVM_PONMUDI.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes; Motion sickness tablets; Cash for entry fees

TVM_NEYYAR.desc: An easy family day close to the city: the elephant rehabilitation centre at Kottoor, then lake and forest at Neyyar Dam.
TVM_NEYYAR.itin:
8:00 AM — Pickup: Central · East Fort · Trivandrum Airport
9:15 AM — Kottoor Elephant Rehabilitation Centre: See rescued elephants being bathed and cared for at Kappukad. (Entry own expense · check timings)
11:30 AM — Neyyar Dam & reservoir: Forest-ringed lake in the Neyyar Wildlife Sanctuary. (Boating optional, paid direct)
12:15 PM — Crocodile rehabilitation centre: Next to the dam, inside the sanctuary.
1:00 PM — Lunch: Own expense
4:30 PM — Drop-off: Central, East Fort, Airport, or your own stop
TVM_NEYYAR.gtk:
🐘 Kottoor: Timings and feeding/bathing sessions vary — we re-confirm before your trip. Follow the keepers' instructions; no touching or feeding the elephants.
🌳 Neyyar: A protected sanctuary — no plastic, no loud music. Boating is optional and paid at the counter.
👨‍👩‍👧 Families: Short drives and short walks: good for children and elders. Back in the city by late afternoon.
☀️ Weather: Warm middays — carry water and a hat. Mornings are best for the elephants.
TVM_NEYYAR.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
TVM_NEYYAR.exc: Lunch; Entry and boating fees; Tolls and parking (private trips)
TVM_NEYYAR.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Comfortable shoes; Cash for entry fees

TVM_THENMALA.desc: India's first planned eco-tourism destination: a suspension bridge over the river, forest trails, a deer park and the Palaruvi waterfall nearby.
TVM_THENMALA.itin:
7:30 AM — Pickup: Central · East Fort · Trivandrum Airport
9:30 AM — Thenmala Eco-Tourism zones: Suspension bridge, forest walks, butterfly safari and the leisure zone. (Tickets own expense · check opening days)
11:30 AM — Deer rehabilitation centre: A short drive within the eco-tourism area.
1:00 PM — Lunch: Own expense
2:30 PM — Palaruvi Waterfalls: A tall forest waterfall near Aryankavu. (Entry own expense · seasonal)
4:00 PM — Thenmala (Parappar) Dam: Reservoir views on the way back.
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Central, East Fort, Airport, or your own stop
TVM_THENMALA.gtk:
🎫 Tickets: Eco-tourism zones sell separate tickets or packages — pay at the counter. Opening days can change; we re-confirm before your trip.
💧 Palaruvi: Best after the monsoon; low flow in peak summer. Entry is by forest department ticket and shuttle.
🌳 Forest rules: No plastic, no feeding animals. Wear shoes with grip for trails.
🛣️ The drive: About 2 hours each way. Pairs well with a Jatayu or Kollam trip on another day.
TVM_THENMALA.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
TVM_THENMALA.exc: Lunch; Eco-tourism and waterfall tickets; Tolls and parking (private trips)
TVM_THENMALA.carry: Walking shoes; Change of clothes; Cash for tickets; Raincoat in monsoon

TVM_THEKKADY.desc: Boat into the Periyar Tiger Reserve, walk through cardamom and pepper plantations, and spend an evening at a Kathakali or Kalaripayattu show in Kumily.
TVM_THEKKADY.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Pickup & drive: About 260 km via Kottayam, roughly 7–8 hours. Overnight in Thekkady. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Periyar Lake boat cruise: Spot elephants, bison and deer at the water's edge. (Tickets paid direct · book early)
Day 2 · midday — Spice plantation walk: Cardamom, pepper, cinnamon and coffee with a local guide. (Paid direct)
Day 2 · evening — Kathakali or Kalaripayattu show: Kerala's classical dance-drama or martial art in Kumily. (Optional, paid direct)
Day 3 — Drive home: Leave after breakfast; back in Trivandrum by evening.
TVM_THEKKADY.gtk:
🛶 Periyar boating: Limited seats per sailing — reach early or book online. Animal sightings are never guaranteed.
🌿 Spice shopping: Buy from plantations or government outlets for fair prices. Ask before photographing workers.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel in Kumily or Thekkady. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🧥 Weather: Pleasant all year, cool nights. Leeches on forest trails in the wet season — wear socks.
TVM_THEKKADY.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; All Thekkady sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
TVM_THEKKADY.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Boat, plantation and show tickets; Tolls and parking
TVM_THEKKADY.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes; Binoculars; Cash for tickets

TVM_CIRCUIT.desc: The classic Kerala holiday in one loop: tea hills in Munnar, spice and wildlife in Thekkady, and a night on the Alappuzha backwaters.
TVM_CIRCUIT.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Trivandrum to Munnar: About 290 km, waterfalls on the climb. Overnight in Munnar. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 — Munnar sightseeing: Eravikulam Park, Tea Museum, Mattupetty Dam and Top Station. (Entry fees paid direct)
Day 3 — Munnar to Thekkady: About 106 km through cardamom hills; spice plantation walk.
Day 4 — Thekkady: Periyar Lake boat cruise and an evening Kathakali show. (Tickets paid direct)
Day 5 — Thekkady to Alappuzha: About 140 km; board your houseboat for a night on the backwaters. (Houseboat booked by you)
Day 6 — Alappuzha to Trivandrum: About 155 km; home by afternoon.
TVM_CIRCUIT.gtk:
🚤 Houseboats: Book a licensed houseboat early in peak season (Dec–Jan). Check-in is usually around noon, check-out next morning.
🐐 Eravikulam: Usually closed for the tahr calving season around Feb–Mar. Book tickets ahead on busy days.
🏨 Your stays: You book hotels in Munnar and Thekkady, and the houseboat. We can suggest areas — your driver's allowances are in our price.
🗓️ Pace: Short drives between stops after Day 1. Want more time? Add a night anywhere — ask us.
TVM_CIRCUIT.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 6 days; All sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
TVM_CIRCUIT.exc: Hotels and houseboat; Meals; Entry, boat and show tickets; Tolls and parking
TVM_CIRCUIT.carry: Warm layer for Munnar; Walking shoes; Swimwear for the houseboat; Cash for entry fees

TVM_KOCHICITY.desc: Chinese fishing nets, Portuguese and Dutch history, the old Jew Town and an evening of Kathakali — Kerala's port city at your pace.
TVM_KOCHICITY.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Pickup & drive to Kochi: About 220 km on NH 66, roughly 5–6 hours.
Day 1 · afternoon — Fort Kochi: Chinese fishing nets, St Francis Church and Santa Cruz Basilica.
Day 1 · evening — Kathakali show: Make-up and performance at a Fort Kochi theatre. Overnight in Kochi. (Optional, paid direct · stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Mattancherry Palace & Jew Town: Kerala murals, the Paradesi Synagogue and antique shops. (Check closing days · entry own expense)
Day 2 · midday — Marine Drive: Waterfront walk before the drive back.
Day 2 · ~9 PM — Home: Back in Trivandrum — or end the trip at Kochi Airport.
TVM_KOCHICITY.gtk:
🏛️ Closing days: Mattancherry Palace and the Paradesi Synagogue have weekly closing days — we plan around them. Dress modestly for churches and the synagogue.
🎭 Kathakali: Arrive early to watch the make-up being applied. Tickets at the theatre, paid direct.
✈️ Fly out?: We can end Day 2 at Cochin International Airport instead of Trivandrum — ask for a quote.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel; Fort Kochi is the most walkable base. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
TVM_KOCHICITY.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Kochi sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
TVM_KOCHICITY.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Show and entry tickets; Tolls and parking
TVM_KOCHICITY.carry: Comfortable shoes; Modest clothing for churches; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for entry fees

TVM_GURUVAYUR.desc: Darshan at Guruvayur's Sri Krishna Temple, a visit to the temple elephants at Punnathur Kotta, and Chottanikkara Bhagavathy on the way home.
TVM_GURUVAYUR.itin:
Day 1 · 5:00 AM — Pickup & drive: About 300 km via Kochi and Thrissur, roughly 7–8 hours.
Day 1 · afternoon — Guruvayur Sri Krishna Temple: Evening darshan. Overnight in Guruvayur. (Hindus only · strict dress code · stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Punnathur Kotta: The temple's elephant yard, home to dozens of elephants. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · midday — Chottanikkara Bhagavathy Temple: On the way back, near Ernakulam.
Day 2 · ~9 PM — Home: Back in Trivandrum by night.
TVM_GURUVAYUR.gtk:
🛕 Temple rules: Guruvayur temple entry is for Hindus only. Men: mundu, no shirt; women: saree or traditional dress. Check the current rules before you go.
⏰ Darshan: Queues are long on weekends and festival days. Early-morning darshan is usually quicker.
🐘 Punnathur Kotta: Keep a safe distance from the elephants. Follow the keepers' instructions.
🏨 Your stay: You book your lodge or hotel near the temple. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
TVM_GURUVAYUR.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Temple-to-temple drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
TVM_GURUVAYUR.exc: Your stay; Meals; Offerings and special darshan tickets; Tolls and parking
TVM_GURUVAYUR.carry: Traditional temple clothes; Photo ID; Cash for offerings; Small bag (phones and bags may need to be deposited)

TVM_RAMESWARAM.desc: Meenakshi Amman Temple in Madurai, the Pamban sea bridge, Ramanathaswamy Temple's great corridors and the shore at Dhanushkodi.
TVM_RAMESWARAM.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive to Madurai: About 300 km, roughly 6–7 hours.
Day 1 · evening — Meenakshi Amman Temple: Towering gopurams and the evening rituals. Overnight in Madurai. (Dress code · stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Madurai to Rameswaram: About 170 km, crossing the sea on the Pamban road bridge.
Day 2 · afternoon — Ramanathaswamy Temple: Famous pillared corridors and the holy wells (theerthams). (Overnight in Rameswaram)
Day 3 · morning — Dhanushkodi: The ghost town and the shore where two seas meet. (Access in daylight only)
Day 3 — Drive home: About 380 km; back in Trivandrum late night.
TVM_RAMESWARAM.gtk:
🪪 Tamil Nadu entry: Interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We check entry rules before you travel.
🛕 Temple rules: Dress modestly; phones may need to be deposited. Queues are longest on weekends and festival days.
🌊 Dhanushkodi: Open in daylight only; strong winds and currents — no swimming. Carry water and sun protection.
🏨 Your stays: You book hotels in Madurai and Rameswaram. Your driver's night allowances are in our price.
TVM_RAMESWARAM.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; All temple drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
TVM_RAMESWARAM.exc: Your hotels; Meals; Offerings and special darshan tickets; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
TVM_RAMESWARAM.carry: Modest temple clothes; Photo ID; Change of clothes for the theertham bath; Cash for offerings

TVM_EV_ALPASHI.desc: Sree Padmanabhaswamy's autumn festival ends with the Arattu — the royal procession to Shanghumugham beach, across the airport runway, for the holy bath at sunset.
TVM_EV_ALPASHI.itin:
1:30 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, station or the airport.
2:15 PM — East Fort & the temple front: The festival decorations around the temple and the tank. Temple: Hindus only
4:00 PM — Your viewing spot: We drop you at an open point on the route or near Shanghumugham before roads close. Roads close ≈3–10 PM
5:00 PM — Arattu procession: Led by the head of the Travancore royal family, sword in hand, with elephants and mounted police. Very crowded
6:30 PM — Arattu at Shanghumugham: The holy bath in the sea at the Arattu Mandapam.
10:30 PM — Drop-off: Pickup once the roads reopen; back home or to your hotel.
TVM_EV_ALPASHI.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Trivandrum or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on 2-day trips)
TVM_EV_ALPASHI.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Offerings

TVM_EV_ATTUKAL.desc: Your own vehicle for Pongala day — a pre-dawn drop before the roads close, a driver who waits all day, and a ride home with your pots once the nivedyam is done.
TVM_EV_ATTUKAL.itin:
4:30 AM — Pickup: Home, hotel, station or the airport. Your pots, rice, jaggery and firewood ride with you.
5:15 AM — Drop near your hearth spot: As close as the police allow — the roads around Attukal close from the night before. Walk the last stretch
10:00 AM — Aduppuvettu — hearths lit: The fire from the temple is passed down the lines of hearths across the city. Pongala begins
2:20 PM — Pongala nivedyam: Priests sprinkle holy water on the offerings. Main ritual
3:30 PM — Pickup at the meeting point: Agreed with your driver in the morning. Load the pots and head home. Expect slow traffic
6:30 PM — Home: Back home or to your hotel.
TVM_EV_ATTUKAL.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Trivandrum or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on 2-day trips)
TVM_EV_ATTUKAL.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Pongala materials and offerings

TVM_EV_BEEMAPALLY.desc: The 11-day Chandanakkudam festival at the pink Beemapally Dargah — the sandal-paste pot offerings, the fair and the lights, with the sea breeze at Valiyathura pier.
TVM_EV_BEEMAPALLY.itin:
4:00 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, station or the airport.
4:45 PM — Beemapally Dargah Shareef: Visit the shrine of Beema Beevi and her son; devotees offer Chandanakkudam — pots with coins and sandal paste. Modest dress · cover your head
6:00 PM — Uroos fair & lights: Stalls, sweets and duff muttu performances around the dargah. Very crowded
7:30 PM — Valiyathura pier: A short stop by the sea on the way back. Walk only
9:00 PM — Drop-off: Back home or to your hotel.
TVM_EV_BEEMAPALLY.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Trivandrum or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on 2-day trips)
TVM_EV_BEEMAPALLY.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Offerings

TVM_EV_IFFK.desc: A car and driver of your own for a festival day — theatre to theatre between screenings, a lunch run, and a ride home after the last show. Book one day or all eight.
TVM_EV_IFFK.itin:
8:30 AM — Pickup: Home, hotel, station or the airport.
9:00 AM — First screening: Tagore Theatre, Kairali–Sree–Nila, Kalabhavan or wherever your list starts. Delegate pass needed
All day — Theatre to theatre: Your driver waits nearby and takes you to the next venue — no waiting charges. Up to 60 km
1:30 PM — Lunch run: To a restaurant of your choice, then back for the afternoon shows.
8:30 PM — Night show: Open-air screening at Nishagandhi or a late show.
10:30 PM — Drop-off: Back home or to your hotel.
TVM_EV_IFFK.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Trivandrum or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on 2-day trips)
TVM_EV_IFFK.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; IFFK delegate pass

TVM_EV_NISHAGANDHI.desc: An afternoon in old Trivandrum — Kuthiramalika palace and the Padmanabhaswamy temple front — then India's leading classical dancers under the stars at Nishagandhi.
TVM_EV_NISHAGANDHI.itin:
2:00 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, station or the airport.
2:30 PM — Kuthiramalika Palace & East Fort: The palace museum beside Padmanabhaswamy temple; the temple front and tank. Closed Mondays · temple Hindus only
5:30 PM — Kathakali mela, Kanakakkunnu: Kathakali performed alongside the festival.
6:00 PM — Nishagandhi Dance Festival: Bharatanatyam, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Kathak, Mohiniyattam — a new artiste every evening. Free entry
10:00 PM — Drop-off: Back home or to your hotel.
TVM_EV_NISHAGANDHI.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Trivandrum or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on 2-day trips)
TVM_EV_NISHAGANDHI.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Palace museum tickets

TVM_EV_ONAM.desc: The state's Onam week in the capital — stages across the city, Kanakakkunnu's lanterns and lights, and an illumination drive down the main road. On the last day, the grand procession.
TVM_EV_ONAM.itin:
5:00 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, station or the airport.
5:30 PM — Kanakakkunnu — main venue: Lantern-lit grounds, cultural stages and food stalls. Free entry
7:30 PM — Illumination drive: Museum to East Fort along the main road, lit up for Onam. Slow traffic
8:30 PM — A second stage: Shanghumugham, Central Stadium or Putharikandam — your pick from the day's programme.
10:30 PM — Drop-off: Back home or to your hotel.
TVM_EV_ONAM.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Trivandrum or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on 2-day trips)
TVM_EV_ONAM.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking

TVM_EV_PAINKUNI.desc: The royal Arattu of Sree Padmanabhaswamy — the deities carried from the temple across the airport runway to Shanghumugham beach for the holy bath at sunset.
TVM_EV_PAINKUNI.itin:
1:30 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, station or the airport.
2:15 PM — East Fort & the temple front: The festival decorations and the giant Pandava figures at the east gate. Temple: Hindus only
4:00 PM — Your viewing spot: We drop you at an open point on the route or near Shanghumugham before roads close. Roads close ≈3–10 PM
5:00 PM — Arattu procession: Led by the head of the Travancore royal family, with caparisoned elephants and the deities on Garuda vahanams. Very crowded
6:30 PM — Arattu at Shanghumugham: The holy bath in the sea at the Arattu Mandapam.
10:30 PM — Drop-off: Pickup once the roads reopen; back home or to your hotel.
TVM_EV_PAINKUNI.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Trivandrum or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on 2-day trips)
TVM_EV_PAINKUNI.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Offerings

TVM_EV_SIVAGIRI.desc: The pilgrimage to Sree Narayana Guru's Mahasamadhi at Sivagiri, Varkala — with a stop at his birthplace in Chempazhanthy and an evening at Varkala's Papanasam beach.
TVM_EV_SIVAGIRI.itin:
5:30 AM — Pickup: Home, hotel, station or the airport.
6:15 AM — Chempazhanthy — Guru's birthplace: Vayalvaram Veedu, the house where Sree Narayana Guru was born.
8:00 AM — Sivagiri Mutt: Mahasamadhi, Sarada Mutt and the pilgrimage conferences. Yellow attire customary
1:00 PM — Lunch: Near Sivagiri or in Varkala town. Own expense
3:30 PM — Papanasam beach & Janardana Swamy temple: The cliff-side beach below Varkala. Paddle only
7:30 PM — Home: Back home or to your hotel.
TVM_EV_SIVAGIRI.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Trivandrum or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on 2-day trips)
TVM_EV_SIVAGIRI.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Offerings and donations

TVM_EV_VASANTHOLSAVAM.desc: The flower show at Kanakakkunnu Palace and the city's Christmas–New Year illumination — an evening drive past the lit-up streets, heritage buildings and churches.
TVM_EV_VASANTHOLSAVAM.itin:
4:30 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, station or the airport.
5:00 PM — Flower show, Kanakakkunnu: Thousands of flowering plants, orchid and bonsai displays, food stalls. Entry ticket own expense
7:00 PM — Light show walkways: The illuminated palace grounds after dark.
8:00 PM — Illumination drive: Museum, Palayam, Statue and East Fort lit up for the season; Christmas lights at the city churches. Slow traffic
10:00 PM — Drop-off: Back home or to your hotel.
TVM_EV_VASANTHOLSAVAM.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Trivandrum or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on 2-day trips)
TVM_EV_VASANTHOLSAVAM.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Flower show entry

TVM_EV_VETTUKAD.desc: The Feast of Christ the King at the 500-year-old Madre de Deus Church — evening prayers and the procession, with a sunset stop at Shanghumugham beach.
TVM_EV_VETTUKAD.itin:
3:30 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, station or the airport.
4:15 PM — Madre de Deus Church, Vettukad: Prayers at the Christ the King shrine; the church grounds are lit up for the feast. Modest dress
5:45 PM — Shanghumugham beach: Sunset on the sea front, 3 km away. Walk only · no swimming
6:45 PM — Evening mass or the procession: The statue of Christ the King is carried round the parish on the evening before the main day (Sat 21 Nov). Very crowded
9:00 PM — Drop-off: Back home or to your hotel.
TVM_EV_VETTUKAD.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Trivandrum or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on 2-day trips)
TVM_EV_VETTUKAD.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Offerings and candles

TVM_VELANKANNI.desc: From Trivandrum on the four-lane road via Madurai and Trichy to the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health — Mass, Our Lady's Tank, Morning Star Church, candle prayers and the shore.
TVM_VELANKANNI.itin:
Day 1 · 4:30 AM — Pickup: Trivandrum Central · East Fort · Trivandrum Airport (on request)
Day 1 · evening — Velankanni Basilica: Via Nagercoil, Madurai, Trichy and Thanjavur; check in, then evening prayer at the shrine. (Lodge list shared)
Day 2 · morning — Mass & Our Lady's Tank: Mass, Our Lady's Tank and the Way of the Cross path; then Morning Star Church and the shrine museum. (Modest dress)
Day 2 · evening — Candle prayers & the shore: A rest after lunch; evening rosary and candles at the shrine, sunset on the beach. (No swimming)
Day 3 · morning — Last prayers, then Madurai: A free morning at the shrine; after lunch about 290 km to Madurai for the night. (Room booked by you)
Day 4 · ~2:00 PM — Drop-off: Central, East Fort, Airport, or your own stop in the city (We leave Madurai 6:30 AM)
TVM_VELANKANNI.gtk:
⛪ At the shrine: Dress modestly; footwear off where asked, quiet in the queues. Masses run through the day in Tamil, English and other languages; we confirm the Malayalam Mass time.
🌊 The beach: The sea here is rough and drownings are reported — paddle only, never swim. Crowds are big: agree a meeting point and keep children close.
🏨 Your rooms: You book your own rooms; we share a list of pilgrim lodges near the shrine and in Madurai. Driver bata and night allowances are in our price.
🛣️ Long drive days: About 12 hours on Day 1, with breaks every 2–3 hours; the way home is split at Madurai. Interstate permit, border tax and tolls are at actual cost.
TVM_VELANKANNI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Driver bata and night allowance; Caretaker for 10+ guests
TVM_VELANKANNI.exc: Your rooms; Meals; Offerings and museum entry; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
TVM_VELANKANNI.carry: Modest clothes for church; Photo ID; Light shawl or scarf; Cash for offerings and candles
